<SPAN USERMARK="F-GL B">.  Ư  &cr;</SPAN>

<SECTION-1 ACLASS="MANDATORY" APARTSOURCE="SOURCE">
<TITLE ATOC="Y">VIII. ӿ     </TITLE>

<SECTION-2 ACLASS="MANDATORY">
<TITLE ATOC="Y" AASSOCNOTE="D-0-8-1-0">1. ӿ   Ȳ</TITLE>

<P>
<SPAN USERMARK="F-GL14 B">&cr;. ӿ Ȳ&cr;</SPAN>
<SPAN USERMARK="F-GL">  ӿ 8 Ǿ ֽϴ.  ӿ 3  系̻, 2  ̻, 2 Ÿ̻, 1   Ǿ   γ Ʒ ϴ.&cr;</SPAN>
